rule.intro: Hay says that something exists. Está says where a known thing is. Es gives the place of an event. Haber in the past: había describes, hubo reports one event.

points.title: Existence
examples: El año pasado hubo una exposición.

points.title: Location
examples: La fiesta es en mi casa.
ser: where an event takes place

rule.watch: From your exam: «fue una exposición» → hubo una exposición; «Marta he estado» → Marta ha estado.

items.q: El año pasado ___ una exposición en el museo.
items.ex: One finished event that existed: hubo.
items.en: Last year there was an exhibition in the museum.
Marta has been ill.

items.q: El año pasado ___ una exposición en el museo.
items.en: Last year there was an exhibition in the museum.

items.q: Marta he estado enferma esta semana.
items.full: Marta ha estado enferma esta semana.
items.en: Marta has been ill this week.

items.q: El año pasado fue una exposición muy buena.
items.full: El año pasado hubo una exposición muy buena.
items.en: Last year there was a very good exhibition.
Marta has been in Madrid.
There's a pharmacy on this street.
The pharmacy is on this street.

items.ex: The place of an event: es.
items.en: The party is at my house.

items.ex: The place of an event: es.
items.en: The concert is in the park.
My keys are on the table.
There are some keys on the table.

items.q: Ayer ___ un accidente en la autopista.
items.en: Yesterday there was an accident on the motorway.

items.q: Cuando llegué, ___ mucha gente en la plaza.
items.en: When I arrived, there were a lot of people in the square.

items.q: En mi pueblo antes ___ un cine.
items.en: There used to be a cinema in my village.
I was very tired yesterday.
My grandfather was a doctor.
The people were very nice.

items.q: El hotel ___ cerca de la playa.
items.en: The hotel was near the beach.

items.ex: A judgement of a finished event: fue.
items.en: The film was very boring.
Is there a cash machine around here?
Where is the cash machine?

items.q: La reunión ___ en la sala dos.
items.en: The meeting is in room two.
There's nobody at home.
There was no class yesterday.
There used to be many trees here.
My parents have been in Seville.
Marta and Ana are very happy.
It's cloudy today.
This coffee is cold.
My girlfriend is Dutch.
The shops are closed on Sundays.

items.q: ___ un bar en la esquina, pero ___ cerrado.
items.ex: New thing: hay. Its state: está.
items.en: There's a bar on the corner, but it's closed.

items.q: La boda ___ en junio y ___ en Sevilla.
items.ex: Events: es, for both time and place.
items.en: The wedding is in June and it's in Seville.

items.q: Cuando era niño, ___ un parque cerca de casa.
items.en: When I was a child, there was a park near home.

items.q: El concierto está en el parque.
items.en: The concert is in the park.
items.full: El concierto es en el parque.

items.q: Hay la farmacia en esta calle.
items.en: The pharmacy is on this street.
items.full: La farmacia está en esta calle.

items.q: The party is at my house
items.a: La fiesta es en mi casa
